title: Under the Rusted Sun
hardCanon: The Temple of Karsh has long been abandoned.
Metal weapons and armour are disappearing from a nearby village.
Villagers hear chanting from the temple at night.
A source prayer asks Karsh to turn iron to rust and invokes stone against those who keep weapons shining.
The AI DM may not invent the identity of the chanters, thief, Karsh or Old Veemor before source extraction.
